title: Persistent problem. V3+ with enabled websockets / no synchronization with client.
symptom: When using multiple AAPS clients with websockets enabled, only one device runs properly for up to 12 hours, then it stops synchronizing BG values. Other data (pump, openaps) still arrives. Disabling websockets on followers resolves the issue.
cause: BGs are coming 0.5 seconds in the future, which doesn't pass validation.
fix: The development version (commit f751b76) fixed the bug; installing that version resolved the issue.
evidence_quote: it's the same issue. BGs are comming 0,5sec in the future, which doesn't pass validation
